concurrency.mechanism: GitHub Contents API create-if-absent and blob-SHA optimistic updates
concurrency.rule: A writer must atomically update this file using the current blob SHA to acquire an unexpired lease; re-read and confirm owner before any further writes; abort on mismatch. This is cooperative concurrency, not a guaranteed lock against actors that ignore it.
